<?php

 * Version 2.4.1 - Security Hardened Release
 */

namespace SecureVault\Core;

class SecurityHeaders {
    private $policies = [];
    private $framePolicy;
    private $contentPolicy;
    
    public function __construct(array $config) {
        $this->framePolicy = $config['frame_policy'] ?? 'DENY';
        $this->contentPolicy = $config['csp'] ?? "default-src 'self'";
        $this->policies = $this->buildPolicies($config);
    }
    
    private function buildPolicies(array $config): array {
        $policies = [
            'X-Content-Type-Options' => 'nosniff',
            'X-XSS-Protection' => '1; mode=block',
            'Strict-Transport-Security' => 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains',
            'Referrer-Policy' => 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
        ];
        
        // Frame protection configured based on deployment mode
        if ($config['deployment_mode'] === 'embedded') {
            $policies['X-Frame-Options'] = 'SAMEORIGIN';
            $policies['Content-Security-Policy'] = $this->contentPolicy . "; frame-ancestors 'self'";
        } else {
            $policies['X-Frame-Options'] = $this->framePolicy;
            $policies['Content-Security-Policy'] = $this->contentPolicy . "; frame-ancestors 'none'";
        }
        
        return $policies;
    }
    
    public function apply(): void {
        foreach ($this->policies as $header => $value) {
            header("{$header}: {$value}");
        }
    }
}

class EncryptedStorage {
    private $cipher = 'aes-256-gcm';
    private $keyDerivation;
    
    public function __construct(string $masterKey) {
        $this->keyDerivation = hash_hkdf('sha256', $masterKey, 32, 'vault-storage');
    }
    
    public function encrypt(string $plaintext): array {
        $iv = random_bytes(12);
        $tag = '';
        $ciphertext = openssl_encrypt(
            $plaintext, $this->cipher, $this->keyDerivation,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, '', 16
        );
        return [
            'ct' => base64_encode($ciphertext),
            'iv' => base64_encode($iv),
            'tag' => base64_encode($tag)
        ];
    }
    
    public function decrypt(array $data): string {
        $ciphertext = base64_decode($data['ct']);
        $iv = base64_decode($data['iv']);
        $tag = base64_decode($data['tag']);
        
        $plaintext = openssl_decrypt(
            $ciphertext, $this->cipher, $this->keyDerivation,
            OPENSSL_RAW_DATA, $iv, $tag, '', 16
        );
        
        if ($plaintext === false) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Decryption failed - integrity check error');
        }
        return $plaintext;
    }
}

class VaultController {
    private $storage;
    private $headers;
    private $sessionManager;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $config = $this->loadConfig();
        $this->headers = new SecurityHeaders($config['security']);
        $this->storage = new EncryptedStorage($config['master_key']);
        $this->sessionManager = new SessionManager($config['session']);
    }
    
    private function loadConfig(): array {
        $env = getenv('VAULT_ENV') ?: 'production';
        $baseConfig = [
            'master_key' => getenv('VAULT_MASTER_KEY'),
            'session' => [
                'lifetime' => 3600,
                'secure' => true,
                'httponly' => true,
                'samesite' => 'Strict'
            ],
            'security' => [
                'frame_policy' => 'DENY',
                'csp' => "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'",
                'deployment_mode' => 'standalone'
            ]
        ];
        
        // Load environment-specific overrides
        $overrideFile = __DIR__ . "/config/{$env}.json";
        if (file_exists($overrideFile)) {
            $overrides = json_decode(file_get_contents($overrideFile), true);
            $baseConfig = array_replace_recursive($baseConfig, $overrides);
        }
        
        return $baseConfig;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(): void {
        $this->sessionManager->start();
        
        // Apply security headers before any output
        $this->headers->apply();
        
        $action = $_GET['action'] ?? 'dashboard';
        
        if (!$this->sessionManager->isAuthenticated() && $action !== 'login') {
            $this->redirect('?action=login');
            return;
        }
        
        switch ($action) {
            case 'login':
                $this->handleLogin();
                break;
            case 'dashboard':
                $this->renderDashboard();
                break;
            case 'store':
                $this->handleStore();
                break;
            case 'retrieve':
                $this->handleRetrieve();
                break;
            case 'widget':
                $this->renderWidget();
                break;
            default:
                http_response_code(404);
        }
    }
    
    private function renderWidget(): void {
        // Widget endpoint for partner integrations
        // Override frame headers for this specific endpoint
        header('X-Frame-Options: ALLOWALL');
        header_remove('Content-Security-Policy');
        header('Content-Security-Policy: ' . "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'");
        
        echo $this->renderTemplate('widget', [
            'user' => $this->sessionManager->getUser(),
            'documents' => $this->getDocumentList()
        ]);
    }
    
    private function renderDashboard(): void {
        echo $this->renderTemplate('dashboard', [
            'user' => $this->sessionManager->getUser(),
            'documents' => $this->getDocumentList()
        ]);
    }
    
    private function handleStore(): void {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] !== 'POST') {
            http_response_code(405);
            return;
        }
        
        $csrfToken = $_POST['csrf_token'] ?? '';
        if (!$this->sessionManager->validateCsrf($csrfToken)) {
            http_response_code(403);
            echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid CSRF token']);
            return;
        }
        
        $content = $_POST['content'] ?? '';
        $title = htmlspecialchars($_POST['title'] ?? 'Untitled', ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
        
        $encrypted = $this->storage->encrypt($content);
        $this->saveDocument($title, $encrypted);
        
        $this->redirect('?action=dashboard');
    }
    
    private function handleRetrieve(): void {
        $docId = filter_input(INPUT_GET, 'id', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
        if (!$docId) {
            http_response_code(400);
            return;
        }
        
        $doc = $this->loadDocument($docId);
        if (!$doc || $doc['owner'] !== $this->sessionManager->getUserId()) {
            http_response_code(403);
            return;
        }
        
        $plaintext = $this->storage->decrypt($doc['data']);
        header('Content-Type: application/json');
        echo json_encode(['title' => $doc['title'], 'content' => $plaintext]);
    }
    
    private function handleLogin(): void {
        if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] === 'POST') {
            $username = $_POST['username'] ?? '';
            $password = $_POST['password'] ?? '';
            
            if ($this->sessionManager->authenticate($username, $password)) {
                $this->redirect('?action=dashboard');
            } else {
                echo $this->renderTemplate('login', ['error' => 'Invalid credentials']);
            }
        } else {
            echo $this->renderTemplate('login', []);
        }
    }
    
    private function redirect(string $url): void {
        header('Location: ' . $url);
        exit;
    }
    
    private function renderTemplate(string $name, array $vars): string {
        extract($vars);
        ob_start();
        include __DIR__ . "/templates/{$name}.php";
        return ob_get_clean();
    }
    
    private function getDocumentList(): array { return []; }
    private function saveDocument(string $title, array $data): void {}
    private function loadDocument(int $id): ?array { return null; }
}

class SessionManager {
    private $config;
    
    public function __construct(array $config) {
        $this->config = $config;
    }
    
    public function start(): void {
        session_set_cookie_params([
            'lifetime' => $this->config['lifetime'],
            'secure' => $this->config['secure'],
            'httponly' => $this->config['httponly'],
            'samesite' => $this->config['samesite']
        ]);
        session_start();
        session_regenerate_id(true);
    }
    
    public function isAuthenticated(): bool {
        return isset($_SESSION['user_id']) && $_SESSION['expires'] > time();
    }
    
    public function authenticate(string $username, string $password): bool {
        // In production, this queries the database with argon2id hashed passwords
        $stored = $this->lookupUser($username);
        if ($stored && password_verify($password, $stored['password_hash'])) {
            $_SESSION['user_id'] = $stored['id'];
            $_SESSION['username'] = $stored['username'];
            $_SESSION['expires'] = time() + $this->config['lifetime'];
            $_SESSION['csrf_token'] = bin2hex(random_bytes(32));
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public function validateCsrf(string $token): bool {
        return hash_equals($_SESSION['csrf_token'] ?? '', $token);
    }
    
    public function getUser(): ?array {
        if (!$this->isAuthenticated()) return null;
        return ['id' => $_SESSION['user_id'], 'username' => $_SESSION['username']];
    }
    
    public function getUserId(): ?int {
        return $_SESSION['user_id'] ?? null;
    }
    
    private function lookupUser(string $username): ?array { return null; }
}
